name: PM - Main Session Priority Pickup
contract_reason: A bounded main-session checkpoint must pick up new or aging P0/P1 current-window, ticker-debt, and cron-error handoffs within thirty minutes during the Phoenix operating window.
description: Every-30-minute review-only main-session priority pickup. It refreshes the non-aging main-session priority handoff, selects one P0/P1 handoff, and persists an explicit Main disposition. It never executes a repair, PM proof, agent packet, lane lease, ticker import, canon/portfolio change, or finance/account action.

payload.text:
Priority pickup checkpoint. Work in C:\Users\Veritas\.openclaw\workspace.

1. Run exactly: python scripts\main_session_escalation_consumer.py --context main_session --priority-observation-source main_session --write --validate
2. Run exactly: python scripts\main_session_action_executor.py --context main_session --write --validate
3. Read tmp\main-session-priority-handoff.json and tmp\main-session-action-executor.json. If either validation is not ok, report only its path, failed control, and named owner.
4. If selected priority is P0/P1 and disposition.status is pending, claim it with this exact PowerShell sequence:
$selectedPriority = (Get-Content -LiteralPath 'tmp\main-session-priority-handoff.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).selected_item
python scripts\main_session_escalation_consumer.py --context main_session --priority-observation-source main_session --write --validate --priority-id $selectedPriority.priority_id --priority-disposition accepted
Verify the matching accepted entry in state\main-session-priority-disposition-ledger.jsonl, then route its named bounded review/repair owner. For defer/block, replace accepted and add a factual --priority-note. Do not close without its acceptance proof.
5. P2 is monitor-only; it must not preempt generic PM work or require a claim.
6. Do not execute a repair, generic PM proof, --execute-safe, --execute-one, finance-agent packet, helper spawn, or lane lease. Reply NO_REPLY only when no P0/P1 main-session action is required.

Boundaries: review/routing only; no ticker or SQL import, canon/portfolio/cash/sizing/risk mutation, capital deployment, paper/live/brokerage/account action, money movement, config/auth/runtime mutation, external delivery, archive/delete, or owner approval inference.
